[[File:Celastrus bark detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Celastrus bark''' is a type of wood harvested from a [[celastrus tree]]. The bark can be fletched into a [[battlestaff]] using a [[knife]] with level 40 [[Fletching]], granting 80 Fletching experience.

One Celastrus tree produces a minimum of 3 bark, where each harvest has a chance of using up one of the "lives" of the celastrus patch, much like harvesting [[herb patch]]es. Similar to other variable-yield patches, the yield of Celastrus bark can be increased by using [[magic secateurs]],{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1092832728830095360|date=05 February 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109014|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=I can't offer to go read the code for you from here, but I think so.}} [[supercompost]], [[ultracompost]], [[attas seed]],{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1250487359730302978|date=15 April 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105048|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=Yes, that effect is tied into the core of harvesting where it does indeed affect Celastrus.}} and having higher Farming levels. [[Nature offerings]] do '''not''' increase the yield of Celastrus bark, however.

Celastrus bark can also be used for [[tick manipulation]] training on a 4-tick cycle to receive greatly improved experience rates. An expanded explanation on tick manipulation and Celastrus bark's use case can be found on that page.
